purpose: Test feature access against matched nonlinear score-only and feature-only controls, with automatic eight-class predictions
prior_diversity_finding: Broader majority coverage alone was already tested and did not resolve the balanced neural model's false alerts; this is not a rerun of that recipe
fit_rows: Unchanged 270326-row capped sample of existing grouped fit partition; all 8 classes, including 50000 Benign, 40913 Recon and 27151 Spoofing rows
feature_transform: Same 39 flow features and original train-fitted scaler; includes Number and Tot sum; no new scaler fitting or feature selection
score_transform: Same two frozen 8-class score vectors and log clipping at 1e-6 as linear fusion; no new neural fits
budget: 15 fits: feature-only once per seed, score-only and hybrid once per seed/lane; exactly 800 trees per fit, at most 15 leaves per tree; not neural-work or parameter-matched
freeze: Save all models before scoring audit rows; calibration unused; no search or threshold tuning
audit: Unchanged 408027 grouped audit rows, already explored, not independent confirmation
screen: Hybrid exceeds feature-only and nonlinear score-only macro-F1 in all six pairs; also exceeds existing centralized macro-F1 and both rare-class F1 scores without increasing its benign false-alert rate; report each component separately
fallback_screen: If hybrid adds no consistent benefit, separately assess feature-only against centralized reference on all three seeds using the same macro-F1, both rare-F1 and benign false-alert checks; no silent hybrid promotion
latency: Local two-thread CPU, batch sizes 1 and 512, 3 warmups and 30 repeats; neural forward cost included for score-only and hybrid paths
